Background: Melanoma, the deadliest human skin cancer, frequently harbors activating BRAF mutations, with V600E being the most prevalent. These alterations drive constitutive activation of the MAPK pathway, promoting uncontrolled cell proliferation, survival, and dissemination. The advent of BRAFi and MEKi has significantly improved outcomes in BRAF V600-mutant melanoma. However, therapeutic resistance remains a major clinical barrier.
